_comment: The fr and es UI packs carried German text for these keys after a machine-translation pass that pivoted through German. English source is copied from en/<namespace>.json so the stamped source_sha256 hashes the real source. Translations are agent drafts pending native review (localization-work-queue.mdc): German text shown to a French or Spanish operator is a shipped defect; a reviewed-pending French or Spanish string is not. Array-indexed bullet leaves under pages headers are omitted — the batch applier cannot replace list elements.
